core_problem_solved: To provide a dynamic mocking framework for Java that allows for the creation of mock objects to facilitate Test-Driven Development (TDD) by isolating the class under test.
key_features: A dynamic mocking framework that creates mocks for interfaces and classes at runtime
An expressive, expectation-based API using Hamcrest matchers to define expected behavior and constraints
A focus on TDD principles and clear, readable test definitions
era_and_niche: A pioneering and influential mocking framework in the Java TDD community in the mid-2000s, serving as a direct competitor to EasyMock. This is its modern coordinate.
reason_for_obsolescence: This is a **legacy library**. While historically important for popularizing TDD in Java, its expectation-based syntax and the entire framework were almost completely superseded by the more flexible and readable 'stubbing' approach of **`org.mockito:mockito-core`**. Mockito is now the de facto industry standard for mocking in Java.
